messages:
Eli: quick sync idea 00-250 dev signups goal. build a tiny refapp + a 'run in codespaces' playground so folks can try the micro-bench w/o local setup.
Nora: love the low-friction angle. timeline?
Eli: repo announce Mon, short tutorial Tue, live 30-min workshop Thu. one social push + 1 reminder.
Sam: messaging split: Variant A = data-first (stat up front). Variant B = playbook-first (show 3-step dev flow). track with utm_variant.
Jae: bench narrative for landing: 1) common pain: unpredictable inference spend, 2) demo levers: batching + prefix cache + light quant, 3) reproducible outcome: median per-call cost reduced ~55% on our sample prompts. Keep conservative.
Eli: hero stat: "See ~50% median token-cost reduction in minutes". Add range: "~35-65% depending on prompt length."
Nora: routing: form -> HubSpot list 'community_playground'. Hidden fields utm_variant, repo_action. If user runs codespace or forks -> set hubspot property engaged=true and post to #sdr-inbound.
Sam: devrel-bot: can you seed repo with Codespaces devcontainer + bench.sh and a smoke CI that outputs bench_summary.json?
devrel-bot: seeded repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/playground-refapp. bench.sh produces JSON {"rps":...,"median_latency_ms":...,"token_cost_usd":...}. GH codespaces template included.
Jae: webhook snippet to fire on star/fork (GH actions): ```json
{"event":"gh_signal","type":"star|fork","repo":"playground-refapp","utm_variant":"A"}
```
Nora: CRM rules: EU registrants -> EU SDR queue. Company_size>500 -> enterprise route. codespace_run -> mark 'high_engagement'. Also add Segment event for product analytics: event = 'refapp_run'.
Eli: social assets: short X thread (3 tweets) + LinkedIn post. Two headline variants for ad A/B. Link to codespace quickstart + repo.
Sam: webinar plan: 8-min intro, 12-min live run-in-codespace showing bench output, 10-min Q&A. Ask eng to volunteer for live infra monitoring.
Nora: post-webinar: recording + 1-pager + quick survey (priority: latency/cost/quality). Map survey to HubSpot property post_webinar_priority.
Eli: deliverables: repo PR (bench + codespace) by Tue EOD (Sam), landing + form by Wed morning (Nora), slides by Wed EOD (Jae), social copy Wed morning (Sam).
Sam: noted. I'll PR bench and devcontainer tonight.
Nora: I'll wire HubSpot + Segment and set routing rules.
Eli: thanks all. keep claims verifiable and include reproduction steps in README. :rocket:
